def get_gcd(a, b):
    gcd_value = a if a > b else b
    while True:
        if a % gcd_value == 0 and b % gcd_value == 0:
            return gcd_value
        gcd_value -= 1

def compute_diff(x, y, a, b):
    num = abs(x * b - y * a)
    den = y * b
    return num, den

def main():
    x, y, n = map(float, input().split())

    if n > y:
        g = get_gcd(int(x), int(y))
        if g != 1:
            x /= g
            y /= g
        print(f"{x}/{y}")
        return

    min_ratio = 1e9
    best_num = 0
    best_den = 0

    b = n
    while b >= 1:
        a = (x * b) / y
        a_floor = int(a)
        a_ceil = a_floor + 1 if a - a_floor > 1e-9 else a_floor

        if abs(a - a_floor) < 1e-9:
            best_num = a_floor
            best_den = int(b)
            break
        else:
            num, den = compute_diff(x, y, a_floor, b)
            ratio = num / den
            if ratio < min_ratio:
                min_ratio = ratio
                best_num = a_floor
                best_den = int(b)
            elif abs(ratio - min_ratio) < 1e-9 and a_floor < best_num:
                best_num = a_floor
                best_den = int(b)

            num, den = compute_diff(x, y, a_ceil, b)
            ratio = num / den
            if ratio < min_ratio:
                min_ratio = ratio
                best_num = a_ceil
                best_den = int(b)
            elif abs(ratio - min_ratio) < 1e-9 and a_ceil < best_num:
                best_num = a_ceil
                best_den = int(b)

        b -= 1

    g = get_gcd(best_num, best_den)
    if g != 1:
        best_num //= g
        best_den //= g
    print(f"{best_num}/{best_den}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
